project_context.aesthetic: Sophisticated, minimal, premium enterprise SaaS. Editorial, data-focused. High-end analytics feel.
project_context.tech_stack: Laravel 11, Blade, Vanilla JS SPA, Tailwind CSS
project_context.core_directive: Reimagine the visual language. Preserve all functionality but reinvent the experience to be memorable, premium, and calm under complexity. Design like an elite founding design team.

sidebar_nav.selected_state: White rounded pill (radius: 9999px), subtle shadow, black text
sidebar_nav.icons: Phosphor Icons via CDN (e.g., `<script src="https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web"></script>`). Use thin-stroke weight (`ph-thin`) to optically balance with Manrope Light. Preferred over FontAwesome for this precise editorial feel.

kpi_hero_panel.value_typography: text-6xl or text-7xl, font-light, tracking-tighter, color #111111
kpi_hero_panel.accent: Lime #DFFF00 used ONLY for the delta indicator (e.g., +14%) or a tiny 4px status dot.

analytical_chart_card.charts: Native SVG via Vanilla JS. Thin lines (1px stroke), completely hidden Y-axis grid lines, muted X-axis lines (#F5F5F2). Plot line color: #111111. Highlighted/hover point: #DFFF00 with a subtle white halo. Floating tooltip with smooth interpolation on hover.

data_table.container: Background #FFFFFF, no heavy borders, generous whitespace.
data_table.rows: Generous height (64px minimum), very subtle bottom border (#FAFAF7), row hover bg #FAFAF7.
data_table.status_pills: Rounded pill, soft powder blue bg (#E3EEF4) with dark text, or lime bg (#DFFF00) with black text for 'critical/live'.
data_table.actions: Contextual, appear on hover, thin outline icons. No spreadsheet clutter.

buttons.primary: Black #111111 bg, White text, pill shape, hover scale 1.02.
buttons.secondary: White bg, 1px #E5E5DF border, Black text, pill shape, hover bg #FAFAF7.
buttons.danger: Soft red bg (or #FF3B30 text on ghost) to maintain calm UI.

drawer_side_panel.note: CRITICAL: Never use transparent background. Must be fully opaque.

command_palette.typography: Large input text (text-2xl), subtle search icon.

executive_dashboard.concept: The Hero Screen. Asymmetric, breathing room, editorial hierarchy. Avoids standard 4-KPI blocks.
executive_dashboard.hero_column: col-span-4. A massive 'One-Number' KPI hero (e.g., Total Revenue / Collections). Typography scales to text-7xl. Almost empty card, just the massive number, a tiny lime delta, and an overarching label.
executive_dashboard.signature_visualization: col-span-8. 'Operational Pulse'. A live, interpolating SVG chart showing SLA heat and activity density over the day. No standard axes. Looks like scientific instrumentation. Hovering reveals data points.
executive_dashboard.supporting_insights: A seamless powder-blue panel (#E3EEF4) stretching col-span-12 underneath, containing 3 distinct insight data points without interior dividers.
executive_dashboard.tables: Pushed to the bottom or secondary tabs. Do not clutter the initial viewport.

onboarding_wizard.layout: Full screen. No sidebar. Deeply generous padding (e.g., p-24).
onboarding_wizard.visuals: Massive greeting typography (text-6xl, light weight). Form fields are oversized and bare-minimum (e.g., just a single underline or large soft input).
onboarding_wizard.progress: Tiny subtle pills at the top. Smooth 350ms transitions between steps.

leads_pipeline.concept: Calm Kanban. High density without looking crowded.
leads_pipeline.cards: White surface, 1px border. Drag-and-drop utilizes subtle tilt and shadow lift.
leads_pipeline.drawer: Lead Detail Drawer opens from right. Tabbed interface (Activity, Qualify, Comm) with a 'Live Workflow Journey train-tracker' spanning the top as a subtle timeline.

inventory.visuals: Instead of a spreadsheet of plots, display a geometric, minimalist map/grid of projects/phases/plots. Available = Outline, Sold = Solid Black, Hold = Soft Blue, Selected = Electric Lime.

workflow_builder.nodes: Subtle border #333, text #FFF. Connections are neon/lime thin strokes (#DFFF00). Emphasizes power, precision, and control.

messaging.layout: Split pane (List on left, Thread on right). Bubble borders are 16px radius, flat. WhatsApp uses subtle green indicator, Email uses blue. Very quiet UI.

profiles_settings.layout: Sidebar within the view for sub-nav. Clean key-value pairs for info. Edit states are inline. Handles massive 12-role hierarchy cleanly.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack_enforcement: You are writing Laravel Blade templates and Vanilla JS. NO React. NO Shadcn. Use utility classes (Tailwind) extensively.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
instructions_to_main_agent.charting: Charts MUST be native SVG + Vanilla JS to maintain the ultra-custom editorial aesthetic. DO NOT use Chart.js or standard libraries.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use Phosphor Icons via CDN (`ph-thin` or `ph-light` classes). Do not use generic emoji or thick SVG icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.transparency: DO NOT use complete `transparent` backgrounds on headers, overlays, or any surface with content underneath. Use opaque or heavy backdrop-blur.
instructions_to_main_agent.motion_js: Handle transitions via Tailwind classes (`transition-all duration-250 ease-out`). Use Vanilla JS to toggle state classes (e.g., `.is-active`).
instructions_to_main_agent.html_structure: Ensure semantic HTML. Use grid spans effectively.

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Behave like an elite product design team. Enterprise software must be desirable. Emotional target: 'What software is this? I want this for my company.'
universal_guidelines.tension: Use tension: very large + very small type, dense info + empty space, quiet UI + one electric accent, strict grid + deliberate asymmetry.
universal_guidelines.reduction: REDUCE UI. Collapse controls, remove obvious labels/icons, merge cards. Premium = proportion+typography+motion+detail+restraint+intelligence, NOT decoration.
universal_guidelines.typography_as_architecture: Numbers have presence, labels are quiet, dramatic controlled scale.
universal_guidelines.motion_meaning: Motion communicates relationship/hierarchy/causality/state. Numbers roll, graphs interpolate, panels expand from source. Nothing bounces meaninglessly.
universal_guidelines.micro_details: Obsess over alignment, baselines, icon optical size, border opacity, radius consistency, empty/loading states, keyboard nav, tooltips.
universal_guidelines.speed: Design for speed: keyboard shortcuts, command search, contextual actions, smart defaults.
